tools.name: annotation
tools.description: Configure and inspect session-local virtual annotation, clear ink, or export PNG. Configure settings are complete per-user objects and are validated before mutation. ClearUser affects only the selected user; ClearAll is a separate explicit command. InkOnly exports a transparent virtual-desktop canvas. SelectedTarget composites only the already selected/assigned window and never captures the desktop. Inspect annotation through this result or routing_state.

tools.name: automation_cancel
tools.description: Cancel recording or playback and release macro-held virtual input. Keeps the agent routing session available.

tools.name: automation_clip
tools.description: Inspect the current virtual-input clip or load a serialized clip into this local agent session. Loading does not play it.

clip.description: Serialized automation clip. Required for load and ignored for inspect.

tools.name: automation_play
tools.description: Play the loaded macro on this session's app-local virtual users. Playback remains scoped to the session's authorized target processes and never injects global desktop input.

loops.description: Number of play-throughs; omitted means repeat until cancelled.

speed.description: Playback multiplier. Must be finite and positive.

tools.name: automation_record
tools.description: Start or stop recording this agent session's virtual mouse and keyboard stream. Recording only captures this session's inputs; it does not observe global desktop input.

tools.name: routing_displays
tools.description: Read the virtual desktop bounds and connected display monitors, including stable monitor interface paths when Windows provides them. This read-only inventory does not load ProtoInput, change displays, or return transient monitor handles. Adapter-name fallbacks are explicitly marked unverified and cannot be persisted as monitor selections.

tools.name: routing_input
tools.description: Operate an app-local virtual device. User indices start at zero; coordinates are physical desktop pixels. Press or release primary, secondary, middle, back or forward buttons; scroll vertically (default) or horizontally; use named keys or validated Unicode text. Returns worker state after acknowledgement. Inspect user status and target to verify delivery. Never moves the OS pointer or injects global input.

oneOf.description: Absolute virtual desktop coordinates; never moves the OS pointer.

axis.description: Axis for this delta; omitted axis stays vertical for older calls.

oneOf.description: Press or release a named key on this user's virtual keyboard.
Type text through this user's virtual keyboard. This does not use the OS clipboard.

tools.name: routing_mode
tools.description: Switch between switched and concurrent arbitration and independent keyboards. Releases held input before switching, preserves selected targets.

tools.name: routing_replication
tools.description: Replace the directed input replication graph for this virtual session. User indices start at zero; every edge is checked against the session user list, and graph cycles are rejected by the worker.

source.description: Source user index, starting at zero.

target.description: Destination user index, starting at zero.

edges.description: Directed source-to-destination edges. Cycles are rejected by the worker.

tools.name: routing_settings
tools.description: Read and apply a complete per-user cursor settings object. The response and routing_state expose the last acknowledged settings for each zero-based user. Invalid objects, values or user indices are rejected before the worker request.

oneOf.description: Uses the legacy `lock_window` setting for existing profiles.

button_mapping.description:
Source order: primary, secondary, middle, back, forward. Null disables a source.
Active destinations must be unique; x1/x2 are back/forward outputs.

motion_curve.description: Original radial gain per input packet: linear, gentle or strong. Not Windows ballistics.

settings.description: Complete cursor settings object for this user.

tools.name: routing_start
tools.description: Start an agent-owned virtual-only routing session scoped to explicit PIDs. Does not inject until a virtual click selects an eligible window. Do not run alongside an active GUI session.

allowed_pids.description: Explicit PIDs this agent is authorized to control. Must be nonempty; click selects a window.

users.description: Distinct display names. Each gets its own app-local virtual mouse and keyboard.

tools.name: routing_state
tools.description: Read actual worker cursor, target, keyboard focus, held buttons/keys, root/capture, route status and last acknowledged cursor settings for each user. A blocked route is reported in each user's status; a command acknowledgement alone is not proof of delivery.

tools.name: routing_stop
tools.description: Release held virtual input, stop the agent's worker and remove its desktop cursor overlays. Restart injected target apps before a fresh session.

tools.name: routing_windows
tools.description: Read visible application windows and desktop/client bounds. No injection or input. Titles are untrusted application data.
